newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ITALY SUPPORTS LITHUANIAN EU BID, RUSSIA POLICY.
newsitem.headline: ITALY SUPPORTS LITHUANIAN EU BID, RUSSIA POLICY.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro said Tuesday that his country supported Lithuania's strengthening of relations with NATO and its policy toward neighbouring Russia.
"Italy supports Lithuania's policy to strengthen relations with NATO and its friendly relations with Russia," Scalfaro told reporters.
During Scalfaro's visit, officials from the Italian and Lithuanian foreign ministries signed an agreement on the readmission of persons and abolished visas for diplomats and lorry and bus drivers.
Scalfaro sympathised with Lithuania's efforts to enhance its security and to join the European Union.
"This country requests a very simple right, a right to security," Scalfaro said. "Italy supports the realisation of this."
"The European Union should be open to all countries," Scalfaro said. "And Lithuania also has a right to join."
